scores.evidence: The s2-layers flowchart (TD) has readable Japanese labels and a caption at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-06.png, pages/mobile-jp-07.png). The s2-table and s5-table stay 2 columns and wrap cleanly on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-07.png, pages/mobile-jp-13.png). Nothing sticks out sideways, overlaps, is clipped or breaks.

metrics.json lists no text-only screens on desktop or mobile. Every content stretch breaks into definitions, a numbered list, a callout, steps, code or a check, and every section ends with a 確認しよう card (pages/desktop-jp-03.png, pages/desktop-jp-05.png, pages/desktop-jp-08.png, pages/desktop-jp-10.png).

All visible text is Japanese, with the English kept for key terms (プロンプトインジェクション (prompt injection), サンドボックス (sandbox)). The diagram labels are Japanese, contrast is fine in the callouts and the dark code blocks, and no control is hidden under the top or bottom bars (pages/mobile-jp-03.png, pages/mobile-jp-11.png, pages/mobile-jp-28.png).

niceToHave: The answer options in q3 (`deny` に `Write(./certs/**)` を書く, and option d with Read(./certs/**)) wrap so that only く is left on the second line at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-11.png, pages/mobile-jp-12.png). Shortening them to 〜と書く, or moving を書く before the chip, would avoid the one-character line.

summary: This preview shows the lesson under review (lessonHash sha256:4f85040f9e462bb2), and metrics.json has no hard failures: no sideways overflow, console, Mermaid or image errors, and no unknown blocks. The diagram, both tables and all code blocks are readable at 390 px, quizzes or checks break up the text often, and no screen shows personal data. The only suggestion is to stop the one-character line wraps in q3's answer options.
